descriptions.zh:
- 创建完成二维码后，用户可使用WhatsApp扫描二维码快速打开对应的商家号码。

- 在调用此接口前，请确保您已有创建成功的WhatsApp消息通道。

- 若您没有已成功创建的WhatsApp消息通道，可在
<props="china">[通道管理](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props>
<props="intl">[通道管理](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props>
界面手动创建WhatsApp消息通道。
#### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为5次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- After the QR code is created, users can scan it with WhatsApp to quickly open the corresponding business phone number.

- Before calling this operation, make sure that you have a successfully created WhatsApp message channel.

- If you do not have a successfully created WhatsApp message channel, manually create one on the
<props="china">[Channel Management](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props>
<props="intl">[Channel Management](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props>
page.
#### QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 5 calls per second. If this limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation appropriately.
